nom: bareMinerals BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30

avis.texte: Love, love, loved this product. It is perfect for those days that I don't necessarily want to put on a full face of makeup, but want to at least look not dead, lol…especially in this GA heat!! I used this while on vacation in Daytona. It was perfect for everyday and beach days. It provided very light coverage while protecting my skin from the UV rays. I will definitely be purchasing this on my own once this sample is empty.

I love this brand and the quality ingredients in this had me hopeful, but I should know that the term 'dewy' is code for greasy. Does not work for me at all. Even a light dusting of power to take down the shine ends up making it look like I'm wearing heavy duty stage makeup.
I really wanted this product however, every time I wore it, do we get in my eyes and burn. Not ideal. I wilp be returning.

I really like this sunscreen!!! It's lightweight, and give my skina healthy, dewy glow. The sunscreen feels comfortable all day. I also love that it is vegan, cruelty-free, and gentle enough for everyday use. A great choice if you want daily SPF without a heavy feel.
I love how sheer and hydrating this is. It gives you enough coverage that you won't need foundation. The only downside is there are only a few shades to choose from.

The Bareminerals sheer medium deep daily dewy sunscreen mineral SPF 30 is a really nice "my skin but better" product. I really enjoyed the easy light thin formula and how it works so well in this warm weather.
First time trying this sunscreen and I'm loving it! Goes on so nicely and doesn't leave my skin looking oily! I only wish it had a higher spf.

I have really enjoyed being able to try and use bareMinerals BARESKIN sunscreen. It feels a little heavy when you put it on, but once you have rubbed it in a little longer it smoothes down to an almost glassy feel. It's SPF 30 which is nice for the face. It easily protects and hydrate your skin.
I was initially worried about the shade match but it's perfect. The sunscreen/tint blends into my skin perfectly. You can't tell there was any type of color. I'd keep this in my beauty routine

I love this is amazing product. I like how it gives the skin a glow moment . And I would definitely recommend this sunscreen. It gives you the look of replacement of your normal foundation. And It's not a heavy sunscreen.
This gave the perfect tint coverage while leaving my skin looking shiny & moisturized! Will for sure be buying again as a new boat day fave

I've been using the Sheer Deep BARESKIN Daily Dewy Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30 for a few days now and honestly I'm impressed with how lightweight it feels on my skin. A lot of mineral sunscreens tend to leave a heavy feeling or a noticeable white cast, especially on deeper skin tones, but this one blended in much better than expected. I also liked the dewy finish because it gave my skin a healthy glow without looking greasy. It layered nicely under makeup and didn't pill when I applied other products on top. The formula felt hydrating and comfortable enough for daily wear. One thing I appreciated most was that it didn't irritate my skin or make me feel overly oily throughout the day. If you prefer a natural, radiant look and want a mineral sunscreen that works well for melanin rich skin, this is definitely worth trying!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I really liked this product for several reasons. First, the color match worked beautifully. It is very sheer, so it works for days I don't want to wear much make up but still look put together. On days I did need more coverage, I layered my regular liquid foundation over it and it still looked fine. It goes on smoothly; it is a thin sunscreen and it absorbed/ dried quickly with a mildly dewy finish. I'd buy this again!

I really enjoyed this product I felt like the coverage was perfect and I looked like I was wearing no makeup. I normally use a competitors brand but I generally do enjoy this product and would buy with my own money

I love a dewy product. I've been using it the last few weeks. Makes the skin appear vibrant. This mineral SPF 30 sunscreen goes on very smooth and light and feels moisturizing. No white cast! It wears really well under my makeup. I will definitely be purchasing when I run out.

Unfortunately, this product was a miss for me. It has good coverage and tint but it smells disgusting and dries out my face. It was also too watery and did not hold its shape well before application. Overall, I would not purchase this.

avis.titre: Fine, but not something I would purchase
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my unbiased opinion. Unfortunately, I wasn't impressed with this at all. The smell was really unpleasant and I didn't like the texture after application. The "dewy" look was achieved, but overall it isn't a product I plan to purchase.

avis.titre: Glowy everyday SPF with a natural tint.
avis.texte: I've been using this as my everyday SPF and it's honestly one of those "skin but better" products. It feels super lightweight, almost like skincare & blends in really easily without that heavy sunscreen feel. The tint is very sheer, so don't expect coverage like foundation, but it does help even things out just enough to make your skin look smoother and more put together. The finish is definitely dewy (like healthy glow, not oily), which I personally love. Only thing! if you have oily skin, you'll probably want to set it with powder because it can get shiny throughout the day.

I make sure to use sunscreen every day and some days I don't want to use anything else. This goes on smoothly and does not feel sticky. It gives my skin a nice glow without looking greasy. I didn't find it to have a very strong scent.
Smells great! Smooth formula that blends into skin seamlessly. Not greasy at all. Love it!
This is actually a really nice mineral SPF that I can wear underneath makeup without feeling greasy! Makeup doesn't look cakey, doesn't get bunched up or start to separate.

avis.titre: BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30
avis.texte: Sheer Deep BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 is the perfect shade for my skin tone. I'm honestly shocked that it matched. There was no cast whatsoever and it blended well over my moisturizer. No streaks or anything.
Perfect, lightweight, with awesome glow, sheer, really really love it!
Light and moisturizing without being oily. It's a nice base when I'm out to be outside all day.
Very good coverage. It will be perfect for summer time with the SPF. I love face products that have a sheer coverage

You apply this product directly to your skin before going out in the sun. It goes on easy and adapts to your skin color. It is weightless and not greasy. I forgot that I was even wearing it. I will be using this on a daily basis. I recommend everyone to try it.

I am so pleased with this sunscreen. It is a new staple in my routine. The consistency is thin but tint watery. This makes the application a lovely experience gliding over the skin. It provides coverage without needing a ton of work to become sheer. There is a slight sunscreen smell but it dissipates quickly. It's more pleasant than most. The dewey glow doesn't ever really dry down but it isn't sticky or tacky. Doesn't pill over or under skincare or makeup. Must try!

I was able to test this product thanks to BzzAgent for my honest review. I love Bare Minerals as a brand and was so excited to try out this product. I wear SPF every day and loved adding this one to my routine. I had tried the shade Medium, and it was the perfect amount of tint to add a nice dewy glow to my skin. It gave such a nice radiance without looking greasy or oily on my skin. I also loved how lightweight it felt while applying, and not sticky either. I've loved wearing this as is with no other makeup products when wanting a super natural day, while still giving a glow to my skin. I use the Bare Minerals Tinted Moisturizer, and this sunscreen paired really well layered under that as well, it's become my go-to complexion combo when doing my makeup! If you are looking for a new SPF to try out for this summer, I highly recommend this one!

avis.titre: Definitely a need from now on!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this I didn't think I needed it but now I'm definitely always gonna have it and continue to buy. I love how natural it looks and makes you feel amazing and protected 100% recommend.
Very lightweight for those days you don't want to wear foundation !

I got this product at the perfect time. My family and I were heading to the beach for vacation. I applied this in the AM prior to going out to the beach for the day. It was very light weight. It comes out fast out of the bottle like water but what's weird, is it felt like a lotion while rubbing into my face. Very easy to rub in and re applied every few hours while wearing a hat. My face never broke out and it didn't leave my face oily. No burn or redness on my face. Would definitely buy it!
This is a nice tinted mineral sunscresn that does not leave a whitecast but leaves a nice glow. I don't think the tint is meant to provide coverage, but it still evened out my skin a bit.

I received BareMinerals Bareskin Daily Dewy Sunscreen as a product for free in exchange for honest feedback. First of all, I like the fact that it is tinted and made with 100% mineral actives. I used it for a good amount of time to give my honest review. I received it in the Medium Deep sheer shade, which was slightly darker for my skin tone. But I love the fact that it melts like butter into your skin and blends with your skin tone flawlessly. First, the formula is super lightweight. It doesn't feel heavy on the skin or leave any extra oily layer like some sunscreens do. There is no white cast or SPF odor. Application is bliss — it glides on my skin and leaves a silky smooth feeling. If used before makeup application, it gives the perfect base to start your routine. The second best thing is that it has a tint in it, so it gives a soft, glowy coverage to your face along with sun protection. Those mineral actives nourish your skin at the same time and leave a glowy, dewy, sun-kissed look on your face, making your skin look super hydrated and healthy. I am actually very impressed with this formula and would love to grab another bottle when it's available in stores. I would highly recommend it to my friends and family because I have already switched to it as my daily SPF routine.

avis.titre: Perfect, Fragrance Free, Clean Tinted Sunscreen
avis.texte: This product is amazing! I shook it before applying it like it says, and the product is so smooth, extremely easy to blend, and has a nice light tint that seemingly disappears into my skin. I was worried it would be too dark but it was perfect. There's a slight sunscreen scent to it, but that's to be expected with any SPF product. It doesn't feel like I'm wearing sunscreen or anything on my skin, and it lasted 2-3 hours on the sunscreen front before I reapplied to make sure I didn't get a sunburn. The quantity is small, but the product has great quality and I will definitely be using the whole product. It is expensive but that is what you get for quality and clean products from a good brand like BareMinerals!

I've been using this BareMinerals BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen SPF 30, and I honestly love how lightweight it feels on my skin. It gives a natural, dewy glow without looking greasy, which is perfect for everyday wear. I also really appreciate that it's a mineral sunscreen — it feels gentle and doesn't irritate my skin. It blends in nicely and works great under makeup or even on its own for a fresh, natural look. If you're looking for something simple, clean, and comfortable for daily use, I definitely recommend trying this one!

To say I'm impressed with this tinted sunscreen from Bare Minerals, would be an understatement! This lightweight, non-greasy sunscreen blends flawlessly into my melaninated skin! It looks as if I'm wearing nothing at all! And there's no ashy white cast! This is a game changer and a must have for me!

This provide some coverage and its not matte nor shiny. It leaves a nice slight sheen. Does not feel greasy or sticky. The coverage is buildable but you will need concealer to cover spots. Provide good sun protection. Will recommend
I like the flexible range of shades, so you can have sun protection without looking casket ready. I do think my skin looks more radiant and love the ingredients listed.

This product was really light weight which I'm a huge fan of. But it was also build able as well. I don't leave the house without spf so I love that this product as that in it. I would definitely recommend

avis.titre: I need to keep this in my makeup bag
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a few weeks to see how it would hold up regarding protection, color, and oxidation. It passed the test! I wore The Bareskin Daily Dewy Sunscreen protects me from the sun and it also gives a dewy glow and tint. I did not even need to use concealer. I used this with a little translucent powder. It covered well.The sunscreen was not sticky or wet feeling on my face. If you want a sunscreen that has a tint and offers great protection, color, and without oxidation this is for you.

Lightweight and effortless, this sunscreen feels more like skincare than SPF. It melts into the skin with a natural dewy finish—no white cast, no heaviness—just a fresh, hydrated glow. Perfect for everyday wear.

avis.titre: Planning to purchase it for summer
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for writing this review. I've been looking for a good daily mineral sunscreen for a long time, and the Sheer Untinted BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 is a solid option overall. Pros:I really appreciate that it uses mineral filters instead of chemical ones. It doesn't irritate my eyes at all (which is a big deal for me), and the texture is lightweight, not thick or heavy. It spreads easily on the skin and doesn't leave that uncomfortable film that some sunscreens do. Cons: It does leave a slight white cast, and right after application my skin looks a bit shiny. However, after some time, the sunscreen settles in and the shine fades. Despite these minor drawbacks, I'm willing to overlook them because it's been hard for me to find a daily mineral SPF that works this well. I'm planning to purchase it for the upcoming summer.

avis.titre: A mineral sunscreen that doesn't leave me ashy!
avis.texte: Bare Minerals was the first makeup brands i ever used (remember those infomercials??) So I was happy to have the opportunity to recieve a promotional bottle of their tinted sunscreen to try! I liked how it blended into my skin and slightly evened it out, giving it almost a blurring effect. The dewy finish left my skin looking healthy and radiant, with no white cast at all like I've gotten from other mineral sunscreens. I did not try layering it with any makeup or other products, so I'm not sure how nicely it plays with others. My only con is it is quite runny, which I'm not used to in my sunscreens. I'm not 100% sure I'd buy this again after it runs out, but it's been nice to try!

I suffer from dry skin and have skin that can be reactive to chemical forward sunscreens. I have greatly benefited from this sunscreen and find myself gravitating towards it when I'm trying a low-key routine. The white cast is very present but I am so happy with the formulation as it does not pill under my foundation. I'm looking forward to purchasing the tinted version!
Good physical sunscreen (vs. chemical) it goes on relatively smooth but I do notice a bit of that sunscreen smell and it can be a bit greasy.
This sunscreen is impressive! It is light weight and does not leave a weird sheen that most sunscreens do.

Leaving this review in exchange for a product from bzzagent. I think I'll use this to replace my super light weight foundation. The tinting is super saturated so it delivers the color you're promised. I accidentally picked one shade too dark but I will still find use for it in my makeup. I don't think it will replace my other sunscreens that I reach out to for the ease. But it will have a place of its own
I actually have overly enjoyed this product! It blends effortlessly! My only con would be it does tend to make me a little oily after about 5 hours but I have combination skin

This product exceeded my expectations. It is smooth and has a light weight feel. It is something you can wear everyday as part of your skin care routine. It doesn't feel greasy and has an added bonus of having SPF. I would definitely recommend this product.
This sunscreen works well for me. I am a medium deep complexion and it does not leave a white cast on my face after I apply it. Light weight with good sun protection!

avis.titre: lightweight, no white cast, hydrating, and gives the perfect
avis.texte: Thank you BuzzAgent. I used the bareMinerals Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 sample, and it surprised me in a good way. The texture is silky and lightweight, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any chalkiness. Even though it's a mineral formula, it blends in completely with zero white cast, which I really appreciate. My skin felt hydrated throughout the day, and the niacinamide gives it a smooth, calm look. It didn't clog my pores or feel heavy, and the glow it leaves is natural — not oily. I also like that it's non‑comedogenic, vegan, and gentle, so it works well even on sensitive skin. Overall, it's a great everyday sunscreen if you want hydration, a soft glow, and clean ingredients without the greasy feel.
Love everything about this product. Goes on smooth, great coverage. It's lightweight and perfect for every day. Received product in exchange for review.

The application of skin tint is super important to me and I really enjoy wearing this one around. The makeup applies sheer and evenly without any white cast. I like how I can layer a bit more if needed. Love the sunscreen option with it that gives the natural look!

This sunscreen is amazing. It feels light on the skin and blends perfectly into my skin with no cast. There isn't a lot of coverage, but if you're looking for something sheer to even skin a little this is perfect. Didn't budge or hurt my eyes!
This sunscreen is honestly the best for those with deeper skin tones. Mineral sunscreen tends to leave a cast but this sunscreen does not. It doubles as a light foundation that covers blemishes.
I like the sheer finish, looks like you have been out in the sun. Easy application, spreads evenly. Great for daily wear.

avis.titre: Just in time for the Summer!
avis.texte: If you want to protect your skin and also have a nice even glow, this is for you! I use this daily as a way to look put together and also protect my skin from the sun. It's also lightweight which is perfect for my no makeup looks and for the spring/summer heat. The shade match is great as well.

I love this tinted sunscreen from Bare Minerals! It has such a sheer and blendable consistency. It leaves a lovely skin-like glowy tint and no white cast, perfect for beach days or days where I don't want a full face of makeup but still want spf protection. I will be using this all summer and highly recommend!

This product is perfect for the summertime! The formula is not too thick, but still applies like sunscreen. It's not irritating and smooths out perfectly on the skin. There is zero white cast which is an added bonus! Overall, my sensitive skin loves this formula and I look forward to continue using it!

This sunscreen delivers impressive performance with a radiant appearance. Its lightweight texture allows for quick absorption without any greasiness. Perfect for daily maintenance, it offers long-lasting durability and a sheer, dewy finish that stays fresh all day.

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying again
avis.texte: I got this right before leaving for a trip for Aruba, I wanted something that would provide protection from the sun and also give me that glow on the beach, this did exactly what I wanted. I didn't burn at all on the whole trip and I felt like I had that natural glow look. This also didn't feel or smell at all like regular sunscreen which I was a huge fan of because I hate that greasy feeling on my face. I will definitely be buying again and using all summer.

avis.titre: Great way to protect your skin in your daily make up routine
avis.texte: Living in South Texas SPF is very important and sometimes I'm not always the best about it. Being able to include this already in one step makes my routine that much easier. I'm a fan of skin care make up combos because it simplify your routine without having to buy multiple products or have multiple steps.
This is the perfect everyday skin essential for the summer. It's light and airy but gives the perfect glow and blur. The SPF makes it a staple for that effortless summer look.

I absolutely love this product. I've never tried a tinted sunscreen before so I was a little hesitant as I didn't know what to expect but this was so good! The color match is perfect, light coverage and SPF protection. I wore it on a nice hot day so an outlet mall. 4 stars as it made me face feel greasy throughout the day but I love this sunscreen and will continue to use it

avis.titre: Lightweight mineral SPF with a smooth, dewy finish
avis.texte: I've been using this daily after my skincare routine, and it applies easily with a smooth, lightweight feel. Compared to other mineral sunscreens I've tried, this one is less heavy and doesn't leave a greasy or sticky finish. It gives a natural dewy look without feeling uncomfortable on the skin. One of the biggest benefits is how wearable it is for everyday use. It layers well over serums and doesn't pill, which makes it easy to incorporate into a routine. The untinted version blends in well with little to no white cast on my skin. I would buy this again, especially for a lightweight mineral option that feels good on the skin. I would also recommend it to anyone looking for a daily SPF that isn't thick or greasy. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.
The product gave a nice dewy look. Didn't feel too heavy, but gave a little glow. For me personally, I would say it doesn't offer much coverage and may not be great for oily skin.

I LOVE a tinted SPF! If you're looking for a dewey tents that works on melanin skin. This is definitely for you. A glad zone smoothly and it's not too greasy and not too sticky. It just leaves your skin looking supple and fresh faced. If it's too Dewey, I would recommend setting it with a setting powder but overall you can wear it by itself or you can wear it under Makeup.

This is a tinted sunscreen so it will not function like a foundation. It's made with clean natural ingredients like niacinamide and ginger root extract. I love how it's vegan and fragrance free. It is pretty dewy so this would be perfect for anyone with dry skin. Very lightweight on the face so that's a plus since many sunscreen can feel heavy. On the other hand, I wish it had more ranges of shades. There's only 4 so it would be nice to add more.

I generally don't go for mineral sunscreens as they tend to have terrible color options. I was really impressed with the color and coverage of the bareMinerals Bareskin Daily Dewy Sunscreen. It leaves a gorgeous sheen and it sheers out well to even out your skin tone without any white cast. As a medium-deep to tan person, I was happy that the color was not chalky, gray or orange on my olive-toned skin. The bottle is also very portable. It's easy to take with you on the go for touch ups. I would recommend it to someone who wants a better shade range when it comes to mineral sunscreens. It also wore very well on the skin and functioned more like a skin tint, which I appreciated. Gifted by BzzAgent in exchange for my honest review.

This is a very nice face sunscreen! It's definitely dewy on my normal/dry skin type but it doesn't feel heavy or greasy. The medium shade works so well for my light/medium skin. If you have an oily skin type this may be a little too dewy. I was sent this as a free sample in return for my honest review.

I apply this product after I wash my face and use a moisturizer. In the morning I let is set into my skin for about 3-4 mins. After which I put on my makeup as normal. This sunscreen did not make my skin overly shiny and did not leave me with the dreaded white cast. It was the perfect shade that blended well. I used my fingers to apply.

I tried the BareMinerals Dewy Sunscreen in the Deep shade, and overall I really like what it does just know what you're getting into. It's very sheer, so this is not something you reach for if you're looking for coverage. It's truly meant to lightly even out the skin tone rather than conceal, and it gives a nice, healthy, dewy finish that makes your skin look fresh and hydrated. I did notice I got a bit more coverage when I applied it with a brush instead of just using my hands, which helped it look a little more polished without taking away from that natural vibe. It still keeps that "your skin but better" look, which I appreciate. My only real downside is the price for the amount of product you get—it goes pretty quickly, especially if you're using the proper amount for sunscreen. I do wish it was a bit more affordable or came with more product. That said, I would purchase this again. It works beautifully as a sunscreen base under makeup and layers well without pilling. If you like lightweight, glowy products that enhance rather than cover, this is definitely worth trying.

I was gifted this for review, but I would absolutely buy it again myself. It has sheer coverage and is a perfect everyday skin tint. I have been wearing just this with a little concealer and it's perfect!
I think this is a great product. It's untinted and universal so u don't have any issues wearing it on days I'm not wearing makeup. I love how smooth it is on my skin

avis.titre: Perfectly for a little coverage and a lot of sun protection
avis.texte: Everyone's doing a tinted moisturizer, but I will say that this one actually felt as though it protects me from the sun. I used it for a full week while I was in Key West, where there was not a single cloud or shade in my access. My skin still photographed well and I knew I was still protected from probably the hottest sun I had experienced in quite some time.

I was so excited to receive the Sheer Untinted BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 and getting to try it for free in exchange for my review seemed like a great way to try a new product. I am always looking for a face sunscreen that doesn't feel oily or sticky. Unfortunately, I found that this caused breakouts along my cheeks and neck. The texture is light, but left my skin feeling sticky and my T-zone extremely oily. Sad to say, this one is a pass for me.

avis.titre: GREAT TINTED SUNSCREEN FOR EVERYDAY USE
avis.texte: I recently tried this tinted sunscreen and I'm really impressed with it. It blends easily into the skin and gives a light natural tint that helps even out my skin tone. It doesn't feel heavy or greasy, which makes it comfortable to wear all day.

Thank you bareMinerals for sending me the Sheer Medium BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 for free in order to review it! I really do love this product, the color may have been a little dark for me, but it will be great with a tan! It does not feel greasy, it doesn't get oily through the day. I love how I don't have to do multiple steps in the morning since this has the little bit of coverage and the sunscreen! Overall, it feels nice when applied. I have dry skin, I did not feel like this made my face feel even more dry, which is definitely a plus!
Doesn't leave a grayish or white hue like other sunscreens. I can blend it in perfectly with my everyday makeup look. Leaves my skin feeling very smooth! No overpowering sunscreen smell.

avis.titre: I enjoyed the way it looked
avis.texte: Not a bad product at all. I was surprised how well it matched and blended into my skin. Definitely needs a setting spray because I did look/feel a little dry after a while. I don't know if it's the white cast from the sunscreen or just the way my products worked with this item. But it looked nice on and I will continue to use.

This sunscreen is perfect for my sensitive skin! I've been looking for an all mineral formula that won't make my skin react! I love how it's hydrating as well and the best thing is that it doesn't leave a white cast!

I recently got the BareMinerals BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 in shade "Sheer Medium" and I couldn't be happier with it. The bottle is cute and it's easy to get the product out of it. It is lightly scented and this shade matches my skin color perfectly. Sometimes I don't want to use heavy makeup up during the day, but still want some natural looking coverage. Well, this sunscreen is perfect because while protecting my skin from the sun, it also gives my skin a natural glow!

Nothing horrible but nothing amazing eithedetrimental. It is a bit thicker than expected. It could also use some additional shades . Having fair skin my only option was to go for the untinted but then on top of the sunscreen I need to add a cc cream and then perhaps a foundation and I prefer fewer products. Certainly the price point is a detriment as well. I received this product free in exchange for my review (thank you) but I wouldn't buy freely.

I received this product for free in order to review it. It's a very lightweight, watery formula that blends into my skin beautifully. It leaves a nice but natural glow. I have used it alone and under makeup and have had no issues. It has quickly become a staple in my morning skincare routine.
I really like my new Bare Minerals Bareskin because it gives me spf 30 protection and soft tint on my face, very natural for daily use.

I received Sheer Medium BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 to try for my honest opinion. It left my skin super oily. I believe that's the dewy look but it didn't work for me. The liquid seemed a bit runny so the application was splotchy in my face. I tried a foundation brush and a sponge and it seemed to not apply very well. It was very sheer. I was hoping to get a bit more coverage. I was excited to try tinted spf since summer is coming up but unfortunately this one wasn't for me.

I was impressed by the sunscreen. I love the fact that it does have a dewy finish and that it is my skin tone. It gives a nice sheer coverage while also protecting the skin. Also I like that this mineral sunscreen is vegan and made with clean ingredients
This product makes my skin so alive. The tone match was perfect. This is definitely great for the summer with the spf

I've been using the bareMinerals Daily Dewy Sunscreen in the sheer deep shade for a little bit now, and I have mixed—but mostly positive—feelings about it. First off, I really like how lightweight it feels on my skin. It doesn't sit heavy or greasy, which is a big deal for me because I hate when sunscreen feels like a layer I can't escape. It blends in pretty easily too, and I appreciate that it doesn't leave that obvious white cast, especially on deeper skin tones. That alone makes it stand out to me since a lot of mineral sunscreens struggle with that.

Lightweight and radiant finish unlike other mineral sunscreens. It it leaves my skin feeling softer and smoother. Brightens, hydrates and soothes skin. Goes on light and smooth! I Love it and would recommend!

I really wanted to love this because the texture is incredible! It's super lightweight and feels more like a lotion than a typical mineral SPF. It gives that perfect "your-skin-but-better" look with just a hint of sheer coverage that looks totally natural and didn't leave a white cast on me at all. I also appreciate that it has skincare ingredients like Niacinamide and Ectoin to help with skin clarity while you wear it. However, it was a bit too dewy for my personal preference…it left me looking a little more shiny than I'd like. That said, if you have dry skin and love a radiant, luminous finish, this would probably be your holy grail. It's a great, breathable mineral option, just be prepared for a very dewy glow!
This product gives a light coverage like foundation and is gentle on your skin. I wore it to an all day track meet in full sun and didn't get a sunburn!

avis.titre: Very nice SPF / make up product!
avis.texte: Never used anything quite like it! Instead of having a white tinted spf I used this and felt like I had a warm glow about me. I went on smoothly and stayed on even when sweating. Super neat product!

I used this as my sunscreen and WOW, the glow is unreal. I placed makeup on top and luckily, it worked well with my routine and didn't peel like most sunscreens I've tried!! It is sheer so keep that in mind!!
It blends very well, doesn't have a smell to it and is super easy to wipe off.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again!
avis.texte: Products were great. It worked very well as described. The smell was pleasant, color blended well with my skin, it was not crazy. I used it at the beach and it stayed on well I would recommend two friends.

Thanks bareMinerals for the free Bareskin Daily Dewy Sunscreen spf 30 Sheer Medium! I was excited to give it a try! I normally do not use tinted sunscreen but I was happily surprised with this color and how well it blended with my skin. The spf 30 is perfect for daily use. The product is a bit more liquidy than expected but a little went a long way. The "dewy" left a little shine throughout the day, for me a bit too much but come summer beach months it may be perfect! Texture wise it was ok, took a bit to absorb into my skin. I also like that it's 100% mineral anctives. Overall, I like the product and will focus use in beach and pool days.

I am with light medium skin tone and was given in the medium color. First, it is too dark (see pics attached) and second, it has no coverage. I do love that it is sheer and thin so although it is too dark for me, I can make it work when I want that bronzy and slightly glowy look. On its own, it spreads easily, but for some reason, foundation does not go on top of it as smoothly. For that reason, itt is almost a primer as well. It is mineral, which I am trying to use vs chemical sunscreen. It has zero smell. It doesn't cause any skin issues. It is lightly tacky when you first apply, but not sticky. It is more watery than other mineral products I've tried and has no white cast because of the pigment. I am not sure if I'd buy product. I'd have the test a shade lighter. Also, the SPF is not high enough, but this still beats a lot of mineral sunscreens out there for its price points and how easily it applies. I can't stand a lot of greasy, pasty and thick sunscreens so I'd still recommend this to others. Overall, it's between a 3.5-4 stars for me.

I love anything with sunscreen as I am fair skinned but I was very impressed with this product. It wasn't sticky like some spf bases give but was a nice thin coverage that helped on sunny days giving a natural glow. I don't wear a ton of makeup but even makeup laid well on top of this sunscreen. Would recommend especially for the hydration which gave my skin a nice spring glow.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: Buttery consistency. Sunscreen with smoothness. Good for everyday wear but doesn't cover imperfections (kinda just blurs them out)
I normally use tinted moisturizers that also contain SPF and this is something I would add to my options. I don't always want to use tinted. It was light feeling on my skin and makes my skin sick
It has a very lightweight texture and does not have any white cast or tint after putting it on. It did not bother my skin throughout the day. Looks hydrating on the skin

avis.titre: I would continue buying this product.
avis.texte: I have been using it everyday, I love the texture my face feels so smooth and shiny.

avis.titre: A great sunscreen for pale girls!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is the ultimate level-up for a daily routine, especially if you're chasing that effortless, hydrated glow without the heavy baggage of traditional mineral filters. Finding a 100% mineral SPF 30 that actually behaves itself on the skin is usually a chore, but this formula is an absolute game-changer. The standout feature is the texture. I opted for the untinted version, and the "Daily Dewy" claim is no marketing fluff—it leaves the skin looking fresh and editorial, not greasy or slick. Because it's untinted, the biggest concern is usually the dreaded white cast, but this melts in instantly. There is zero ghostly residue, even on a pale complexion, which is a massive win for a mineral product. It absorbs incredibly fast, acting almost like a high-end primer that grips onto the skin while providing that essential shield against the sun. It feels weightless and breathable, making it perfect for long days outdoors or layering under a full face of makeup. It's rare to find a product that manages to be both deeply moisturizing and lightning-fast to set, but bareMinerals nailed the chemistry here. If you want a protected, radiant finish without the chalky struggle, this is the one to grab.

avis.titre: Good everyday sunscreen, sensitive skin friendly!
avis.texte: I've been using this sunscreen for a few weeks now and it fits really well into my daily routine. One thing I really like is that it actually matches my deeper skin tone without leaving a white cast, which is hard to find with mineral sunscreens. It feels lightweight on my skin and blends in easily, giving me a nice natural glow without looking greasy. I use it every morning after moisturizing, and it sits well on my skin and under makeup. I also haven't had any irritation or breakouts while using it and I have sensitive skin. The only downside for me is that I feel like I have to keep reapplying it more often than I'd like, especially in the heat. I know reapplying is important with any sunscreen, but I do wish it lasted a bit longer. Overall, it's still a really good everyday SPF and I'll continue using it.

This is my new go to for everyday SPF with undetectable protection. This is a light non-greasy sunscreen with Bisabolol & Ginger Root Extract for hydration and Zinc Oxide for defense, with no white cast. radiant, healthier-looking skin instantly

I've been looking for a mineral sunscreen for its many benefits, but have been reluctant to try some of the most popular brands due to reports of white cast. I received a complimentary bottle of bareMinerals BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 in the mail to review as part of a promotional campaign and gave it a try. The shade I received is Sheer Medium Deep. It works beautifully on my skin tone and would also suit someone whose skin is a shade or two darker than mine. For reference, I have a caramel-colored complexion with golden undertones. The mineral sunscreen has a pretty thin texture- not exactly watery, but less viscous than a serum, so I'd be careful about dispensing too much from the bottle at a time so as to not risk wasting product or run- off. In my opinion, this is probably the only downside, which is also what lends to the lightness in terms of how the product feels on my skin. It glides on VERY smoothly and has a barely-there feel. There is no stickiness and it works well with my other skin care products, so I haven't experienced any pesky pilling upon application! I've been using it under a natural powder with a little blush for my daily makeup look and it works perfectly without foundation. My skin maintains a dewy and moisturized look all day without me feeling the need to spritz my face with any kind of essence to re-moisturize my skin or reinvigorate my look! I 10/10 recommend this tinted mineral sunscreen and would definitely purchase it after I

i use this sunscreen as the last step in my morning skincare routine and before makeup. It leaves a nice finish, not greasy looking or feeling at all. Does well under makeup. reapplying is easy to do.

avis.titre: I would definitely add this to my daily routine.
avis.texte: I've been really impressed with this sunscreen. It's lightweight, blends in beautifully, and doesn't feel heavy. It feels comfortable on my skin all day and layers well under makeup. I also appreciate that it doesn't feel heavy or clog my pores. Definitely a great option for daily use.
This bare mineral sunscreen is great for daily use with an SPF of 30. The sunscreen itself is sheer and dewy with a hint of color. Great for use alone or under makeup!

I have been wearing this sunscreen for about week now and I am usually not a sunscreen wearer because I don't like the smell. But this one apart from being super glowy under makeup doesn't have a strong scent. I like the compact size to throw in my bag. I think it will be really good for the summer to wear alone.

avis.titre: Dewy Protection Without The Heavy Feel
avis.texte: This is a good choice for mornings when I want a no-makeup look that still offers a bit of color to help warm up my skintone. The finish is very sheer and provides just enough tint to even out my complexion without looking like a traditional base. The texture is so lightweight that the focus is clearly on the skin's texture and protection rather than coverage. It's the perfect balance for someone who wants to look polished but natural. ​You have to shake the bottle well before use. It actually sounds a bit like a paint can when you're mixing it up. I've found that the best way to apply it is with a buffing foundation brush. Using a brush allows for a quick, even wash of color and ensures the SPF is distributed properly. On days when I'm wearing a different base, I still dab this over my hyperpigmented areas for that extra layer of mineral protection. ​It's been great for my combination skin because it doesn't cause irritation or clog my pores. One thing to note is that it really does have a high level of dewyness. Since I tend to get shiny toward the end of the day, I've found it's best to use a light dusting of powder or keep some blotting papers handy so the glow doesn't become too intense. Overall it's a great product.

i love a good tinted sunscreen and this is no exception. it's incredibly lightweight, doesn't leave my skin feeling oily, and gives me just a hint of a tan. only reason i gave four stars is because i wish the spf was higher. i'd prefer a 50+ for my face

Such a beautiful finish that doesn't feel heavy at ALL and doesn't leave a white cast on your face. I don't feel like I'm wearing anything like other sunscreens I've used. I'd love to try a tinted one!

I absolutely love the coverage of this sunscreen! The Deep BARESKIN Daily Dewy Sunscreen Mineral SPF 30 gives my skin a smooth, dewy look while still feeling lightweight. I also love that it has SPF built in and its perfect for summer and protecting my skin without needing a bunch of extra products. It's become a staple in my routine. I highly recommend this if you're looking for something that gives you a nice glow and sun protection at the same time!
This is exactly what it says it is. It is sheer SPF that would be perfect for a day by the pool or just running errands. It blends well and feels moisturizing while providing a little glow.

So light doesn't even feel like you're wearing anything. The shade was perfect to my skin tone and went perfectly well with the other bear mineral products I own. I have been wearing this every day and get compliments on how well my skin looks.

If you are looking for SPF protection with a tint, this is a great product! It has a sheer dewy finish, it is not a high coverage product. It's very thin and easy to apply. The tint doesn't end up splotchy like some other tinted SPF's that I've tried. It's just the right amount of tint for the summer and especially for someone who wants a bit of a color and not heavy makeup.

Perfect color match. Easy to use and blend well and smoothly. Gives my skin a very light natural skin tone and not too greasy. Not too heavy on my face. Medium cover but it's very buildable for a full coverage.
I found this product to be really moisturizing. It is a sheer tint. I have really oily skin but I found if I use it under my matte foundation, it hides lines and does not cause oil to pull through:

As a darker skin girl, I'm usually hesitant to test products like this because mineral sunscreens usually leave me purple/gray and tinted products never seem to have a good enough range. However this product is the complete opposite! I teated out shade "Sheer Deep" and it blended so easily into my skin! Directly out of the bottle I was worried that it was too light but on the skin it matched so well that I was starting to wonder if I even put any on. It's a relatively lighter coverage product so id you have dark spots you should consider spot concealing or color correcting as well. I wasn't able to build up additional coverage on my darker spots but that isn't an issue to me since my other makeup products sat on top with no problem. I would definitely recommend for quick and easy makeup looks!

I put the product on my finger tips and watched it melt into my face, leaving a glow and tint. The color blended evenly, even though I didn't think it would be a direct match. It did transfer off of my fingers and onto the bottle and sink, so I was worried it would get on my clothes. Any transfer was easily rubbed off or washed off.
